data.value: This is a Hyper-V checkpoint disk (differencing), which QEMU cannot read. Delete the checkpoints in Hyper-V (their content is merged into the main disk), then import the .vhdx.

data.name: ImportPartitionTableUnreadable
data.value: The partition table could not be read: the machine will boot with BIOS from a SATA disk. Adjust the firmware, the controller and the guest operating system in Hardware.

data.value: Only the disk is imported. Its partitions are those of Windows: the machine takes the Windows 10 settings (SATA, e1000e adapter), to adjust in Hardware.

data.name: ImportDiskOnlyLinux
data.value: Only the disk is imported. Its partitions are those of Linux: the machine takes the Linux settings (VirtIO disk and network adapter), to adjust in Hardware.

data.name: ImportDiskOnlyUnknown
data.value: Only the disk is imported, and its partitions do not tell which operating system it holds: the machine takes safe settings (SATA, e1000 adapter), to adjust in Hardware along with the guest operating system.

data.name: ImportHyperVWindowsAhci
data.value: A Windows coming from Hyper-V booted from Hyper-V's synthetic controller, which does not exist here. If it stops on INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE, enable its AHCI driver before exporting (sc config storahci start= boot in the Hyper-V machine).

data.name: ImportHyperVLinuxInitramfs
data.value: A Linux installed on Hyper-V may have only Hyper-V's disk drivers in its initramfs. If it stops in “emergency mode” reporting that /dev/disk/by-uuid/… does not exist, regenerate it with all drivers in the Hyper-V machine, then import the disk again: echo 'hostonly="no"' | sudo tee /etc/dracut.conf.d/90-generic.conf, then sudo dracut --force --regenerate-all (or sudo update-initramfs -u -k all if the distribution does not use dracut).

data.name: ImportDiskInUse

A Linux whose initramfs holds only the drivers in use (dracut in hostonly mode) will stop in “emergency mode”: before exporting, run echo 'hostonly="no"' | sudo tee /etc/dracut.conf.d/90-generic.conf then sudo dracut --force --regenerate-all in the machine.
